Your custom instructions are in `nam20485/agent-instructions`, `main` branch. Read core instructions first, then follow required/needed links.

Local modules are in `../local_ai_instruction_modules`. Agents MUST resolve dynamic workflows from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors. Agents MUST resolve workflow assignments (by shortId) from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors.

Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required.

Read before running any terminal commands, of if you need Github CL.I

Don't assume your shell is bash. Its probably pwsh. Detect what type of shell you have before running any commands.

Your web-fetch tool is disabled. Use powershell or curl to fetch files from the web. If there are many files, then create a pwsh script to download them in parallel.

Agents must prefer automation-first approaches and use available tools efficiently. Review the local module for the full policy.

Maximize filesystem operation effectiveness using available MCP servers and built-in tools.

Setup script: [setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1](../scripts/setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1)

Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort.

Maintain ≥90% automation coverage for GitHub operations and document any manual exceptions.

If GitHub tools (MCP or gh) are not authorized, initiate the authentication/login flow (e.g., start gh auth login); the user will complete the interactive prompts.

Main repository: https://github.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/main  
Raw files MUST be used; do not use GitHub UI. Convert UI URLs by replacing `https://github.com/` with `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/`.

Core raw URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/main/ai_instruction_modules/ai-core-instructions.md

Authoritative sources: dynamic workflows under `ai_instruction_modules/ai-workflow-assignments/dynamic-workflows/` and workflow assignments under `ai_instruction_modules/ai-workflow-assignments/` in the remote canonical repository. Local golden files, cached plans, or mirrors must not be used to derive steps or acceptance criteria. Delete any such artifacts if present. Changes take effect immediately on subsequent runs. The orchestrator must always fetch and execute directly from the remote canonical URLs listed below.

Required/local modules include:
- `ai-dynamic-workflows.md`
- `ai-workflow-assignments.md`
- `ai-terminal-commands.md`
- `ai-tools-and-automation.md`
- `ai-enhanced-filesystem.md`
- `ai-local-instructions.md`
- `ai-claude-coder-agents.md`
- `ai-development-instructions.md`

Read `ai-claude-coder-agents.md` and individual briefs under `.claude/agents/` before delegating or executing tasks.
